Here is a simple example of how you can write this rule in Semgrep YAML format:

```yaml
---
id: vuln-novnc-ad941fad
title: "Potential XSS vulnerability"
description: "This rule detects potential XSS (Cross Site Scripting) by checking for document.cookie manipulation without 'secure' attribute."
severity: WARNING
language: javascript

pattern:
  - "(?i)(document\\.cookie\\s*=)"
  - "(?i)(?<!;\\s*secure\\s*=)"
  - "(?i)(?<!;\\s*httpOnly\\s*=)"

metadata:
  category: XSS
  cweId: CWE-79
  cve: CVE-2013-7436
---
```

This rule will match any line that contains `document.cookie =` and does not have a `; secure=` or `; httpOnly=`. This is a very basic example, you might need to adjust it according to your specific needs.
